sub: Every number that decides when a warning goes out or a colour changes: what it means, where it is used, its allowed range and every change.
honest: Changing a rule here does not change anything yet: the weather planner, the dryness colours and Field Eye still use their built-in numbers. The server will read these values in a later version (FRONTEND.md section 9).
honest_short: The jobs do not read this value yet. It is saved and logged for when they do.
w_weather_planner_text: The farmer's weekly plan and the weather warnings in the app.
w_dryness_text: The colours of the districts on the region map and the public page.
w_field_eye_text: How satellite pictures of a farm are read and judged.
tip_text: Change a little at a time, for a reason you can name. Example: farmers in Makhmur ignore heat warnings at 31 °C, so try 33.
reason_hint: 3 to 500 characters, kept in the history
reason_ph: For example: farmers ignore the warning at this level
reset_text: From {a} back to {d} {u}. The change is logged with your reason.
no_history_text: This rule still has its starting value.
